sourceFacts: female Chufeng Media artist, first known as a voice actor and later an on-camera performer
actively contacted Li Hao to investigate the metro ghost story and obtained a temporary filming permit
used a smartphone AR waiver and once met fully disguised with sunglasses, cap and mask
now deceased; standard portrait must show her ordinary living professional image, without death, injury, haunting or supernatural effects
designAssumptions: Chinese woman about twenty-eight with shoulder-length softly wavy dark-brown hair, warm brown eyes and a focused approachable face
plain sand-colored trench coat over a muted teal turtleneck, charcoal trousers and ankle boots
holds a small unmarked camcorder ready at chest level as a field-program presenter rather than a glamorous stage idol
sceneConcept: A focused twenty-eight-year-old Chinese media artist and field-program presenter stands alive and uninjured alone against a transparent background. Shoulder-length softly wavy dark-brown hair is tucked behind one ear, revealing a tiny stud earring and warm attentive brown eyes. She wears a plain sand-colored trench coat open over a muted teal turtleneck, charcoal trousers and ankle boots. Both hands hold a small camcorder with a completely blank tan housing ready at chest level, and she wears a restrained approachable smile under soft even frontal studio light.
naturalLanguageDetail: An alive and uninjured twenty-eight-year-old Chinese media artist with shoulder-length softly wavy dark-brown hair holds a small camcorder whose tan housing is completely blank and unmarked, wearing a plain sand-colored trench coat and muted teal turtleneck with a restrained approachable smile under soft even frontal studio light.
